epics.title: Runtime Launch and Health Check Remediation
epics.jtbd: When deploying the application, I want the application and its health endpoints to start successfully, so that the product can be accessed and evaluated.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease runtime health check failure rate from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The application container must start successfully and accept connections on its health check endpoint without 'Connection refused' errors.

slices.title: Resolve connection refused on application health endpoint
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to identify and resolve the root cause of the application failing to accept connections on its exposed port, so that the launch health check succeeds.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application infrastructure is launched via Docker Compose
When the runtime health check polls the /health endpoint
Then the connection must succeed and return a healthy HTTP status code without 'Connection refused' exceptions.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease health check connection refused errors from 1 to 0 per deployment
